fields.description:
First release of the Live Animals & Germinal journey on the Import Notification Service. It lets customs clearance agents and importers notify APHA of live animal and germinal consignments moving from the EU to Great Britain, giving APHA and PIMS caseworkers the information to identify movements and target destination inspections by risk.

Delivers a simplified CHED-A journey (based on the legacy IMP journey) to a Day 1 "safe and legal" scope: from origin of the import through commodities, identifiers, arrival, transport, documents, review and declaration.
